showcase.title: Explore AI in Action
showcase.intro: Discover practical AI use cases and scenarios. Select a theme to start a focused conversation with the AI Assistant and see how these solutions can be applied to your context.

aiDemo.title: Turn every customer request into a next step
aiDemo.intro: An AI Operations Copilot reads incoming requests, understands what matters, drafts a helpful reply, and creates the right follow-up for the team. Less manual triage, more time for decisions that need people.
aiDemo.cta: Explore this use case with AI

preview.title: Operations Copilot
preview.subtitle: Customer support workflow
preview.demoNotice: Interactive simulation with sample data. No live business system is connected.
preview.request: I was charged twice for my annual plan. Can you check the second payment and let me know when it will be refunded?
preview.reply: I found a duplicate annual charge. I have opened a refund request and assigned it to Billing. The customer will receive an update within one business day.

aiDemo.workflowTitle: From a messy inbox to an organised operation
aiDemo.workflowText: The value is not just generating text. The assistant connects the request to the company process, so every answer comes with a clear action and an auditable decision.

steps.label: Input
steps.title: Read and understand
steps.text: Collect requests from email, chat, or a form and identify intent, urgency, customer, and relevant data.

steps.label: Reason
steps.title: Apply company rules
steps.text: Use the knowledge base and business rules to choose the correct route, while flagging exceptions for a person.

steps.label: Action
steps.title: Reply and hand off
steps.text: Draft a consistent response, update the CRM or ticketing system, and assign the next task to the right team.

aiDemo.resultTitle: A useful output, not just an answer
aiDemo.resultText: The assistant turns one customer message into structured information the business can act on immediately.

actions.label: Analyse request
actions.title: I analysed the request
actions.result: I detected a duplicate annual payment for customer #4821.

actions.label: Draft reply
actions.title: I drafted the reply
actions.result: I prepared a clear reply with the refund timeline and next steps.

actions.label: Create ticket
actions.title: I created the ticket
actions.result: I assigned Billing ticket #1048 to the Billing team with high priority.

documentCase.title: Turn documents into decisions, faster
documentCase.text: An AI document workflow extracts data from invoices, contracts, or claims, checks it against company rules, and sends only exceptions to the right person.
steps: I extract supplier, amount, VAT, and due date
I compare with purchase order and policy
I prepare approval or route the exception to Finance

salesCase.title: Give sales teams a clearer forecast
salesCase.text: An AI sales analyst combines CRM activity, deal history, and pipeline signals to identify risks, suggest follow-ups, and make the forecast easier to trust.
steps: I read pipeline changes and account activity
I detect stalled deals and forecast risk
I suggest the next action for each opportunity

aiDemo.note: A human stays in control: sensitive cases, low-confidence answers, and final approvals can always be routed to a team member.
aiDemo.bottomTitle: Could this fit one of your workflows?
aiDemo.bottomText: Tell the AI assistant about a repetitive process in your company and explore how it could be designed, integrated, and measured.

hero.lead: Hi, I am Davide. I design and build end-to-end web products, integrating AI into web apps and business workflows to deliver measurable value.

about.title: About me
about.text: I support projects end to end, from initial business needs to final delivery, choosing the right technologies and solutions for each context. My focus is integrating AI into web products and business workflows in a practical way, with a clear objective: to create added value for the product through better operations, decision-making, and measurable outcomes.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.subtitle: Choose a strategic scenario and start a focused AI discussion with me.

items.description: A strategic discussion for companies that want to reduce manual work, improve internal processes, and introduce AI where it creates concrete operational value.

pillars.title: Listening and Communication
pillars.text: Thanks to a solid background in relationship management, I speak your language, turning your requests into concrete solutions without technical barriers.

pillars.title: Business Impact
pillars.text: I build powerful automation through Artificial Intelligence and native integration with external services (APIs). This eliminates manual, repetitive work, drastically cutting operating costs and increasing business efficiency.

pillars.title: Infrastructure and Agile Method
pillars.text: I set up the ideal environment to keep your application always online, secure, and fast, able to evolve quickly and without downtime thanks to continuous releases.

skills.title: Skills
skills.text:
I manage digital projects **from conception to production**, turning a business need into a solid, easy-to-use software application. Thanks to an agile way of working, I develop projects through continuous cycles that allow constant updates to be released, optimizing time and delivering results that match your goals.
I harness the power of **AI** on two levels: as a daily ally to speed up development, but above all as an engine built into your applications to automate workflows, eliminate errors, and take your business to the next level.

approach.title: How I work
approach.text:
I never stick to a single technology: I choose the stack based on the problem, whether that means a solid monolith or a serverless architecture that scales on its own. What doesn't change is the focus on code quality, maintainability, and clean APIs.
In recent years I have integrated AI into real web products, not as a *buzzword*, but to automate processes, improve the user experience, and reduce repetitive work.
I approach every project with a pragmatic, end-to-end mindset: from Clean Code and DevOps principles to production release, bridging business needs and technical reality.

team.title: Team leadership & prioritization
team.text: I can coordinate work across multiple people, keep tasks clearly distributed, and keep the project aligned with its goals. I pay close attention to prioritization to avoid blockers, protect deadlines, and deliver within the expected timeframe.

focus.title: On-time delivery
focus.text: I organize tasks, dependencies, and check-ins so the project keeps moving steadily without losing quality along the way.

categories.name: Backend Architecture & APIs
categories.text: Design and development of robust, high-performance, scalable services, with advanced management of relational and NoSQL databases.

categories.name: Frontend Engineering & UX/UI
categories.text: Modern, responsive, accessible interfaces, with continuous focus on performance, usability, and user experience.

categories.name: Quality, DevOps & Methodologies
categories.text: Rigorous engineering (OOP, design patterns, clean code, testing), automated cloud deployment, and version-control expertise.

categories.name: IT Project Management & Delivery
categories.text: Functional scoping, roadmap definition, Agile/Scrum sprint planning, and operational project leadership with priority management to meet deadlines.

experiences.title: Experience
experiences.text: My professional journey began in hospitality and food service, where I developed a strong sense of service, communication, and customer needs. After training in software development, I moved into full-stack web development and worked on business applications, API integrations, and custom tools. Today, I combine technical expertise, automation, and practical AI integration to build useful, maintainable solutions that genuinely support each project's goals.

workStyle.title: How I work
workStyle.text: I combine AI integration, API design, OOP, design patterns, clean architecture, and testing to build robust applications. I also care a lot about problem solving, UX, and workflow automation.

sections.title: Applicable law
body: These terms are governed by Swiss law. Subject to mandatory venues, the courts at Davide Carboni's place of business have exclusive jurisdiction.
Davide Carboni processes personal data with care, in accordance with applicable Swiss data protection legislation and, where it applies, the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: Data controller
body: Davide Carboni, Switzerland, is responsible for the processing described here. You can contact him at studio.ing.dci@gmail.com.

sections.title: Data processed
body: Depending on how you use the site, Davide Carboni may process:
• the information you send through the contact form or by email, in particular your name, email address and message;
• the messages and files you send to the AI assistant, which may contain personal data;

• technical data needed for the security and operation of the site, such as the IP address, request date and browser, processed by the hosting provider and, only in memory and for a few moments, to limit repeated requests;
• for chat requests, only the date and time, path, outcome and duration, for statistical purposes. IP addresses, user agents and referrers are not stored;
• the language you chose, saved in your browser.
The site does not use audience measurement or advertising tools.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
body: This data is used to answer requests, prepare or perform an engagement, operate and secure the site, prevent abuse and meet legal obligations. Processing relies, as the case may be, on pre-contractual steps, performance of a contract, a legal obligation, your consent (for example when you voluntarily write in the chat) or Davide Carboni's legitimate interests in communicating and providing a secure service.

sections.title: Providers and recipients
body: Data is accessible only to Davide Carboni and the providers needed for the service: Infomaniak for hosting the site, Groq for generating the AI assistant's replies, and Google for reCAPTCHA verification and for delivering contact form messages through Gmail. No recipient receives this data for advertising purposes.

sections.title: Processing abroad
body: Infomaniak hosts the site in Switzerland. Groq and Google may also process data outside Switzerland and the European Economic Area, in particular in the United States. In that case the transfer relies on an applicable adequacy decision, such as the Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework, or recognised contractual safeguards, such as standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: Retention
body: A request with no contractual relationship is deleted no later than twelve months after the last exchange. Exchanges linked to an engagement are kept during the relationship and then according to the applicable legal periods. Conversations with the AI assistant are not retained by the site. Access statistics contain no personal data. Technical hosting logs are kept for at most the period set by Infomaniak.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Within the limits of applicable law, you can request access to your data, its rectification, erasure, delivery or restriction of processing, and withdraw consent for the future. You can also contact the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner or the competent authority where you live.

sections.title: Cookies
body: The site does not use tracking or advertising cookies. Only your language choice is saved in the browser, in local storage under the key portfolio-language. The site is protected by reCAPTCHA, which may use its own technical identifiers: the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply:
